claims.claim: An August 2025 request for comment to add Markdown formatting to the G15 speedy-deletion criterion was closed with consensus against.
claims.source: voorts, closing 'RfC: Including Markdown in G15' opened by Chaotic Enby on English Wikipedia
claims.quote: There is consensus against including markdown in G15
claims.page: RfC: Including Markdown in G15, closing statement

claims.claim: The closer's stated reason was that a clear majority of editors believe markdown is not consistently an indicator that a page was LLM-generated.
claims.source: voorts, closing statement of 'RfC: Including Markdown in G15', English Wikipedia
claims.quote: markdown is not consistently an indicator that a page was LLM-generated
claims.page: RfC: Including Markdown in G15, closing statement

claims.claim: A second August 2025 request for comment, to add emojis to the same criterion, was closed with no consensus to adopt it.
claims.source: voorts, closing 'RfC: Including emojis in G15' opened by Bunnypranav, English Wikipedia
claims.quote: There is no consensus to adopt this criterion
claims.page: RfC: Including emojis in G15, closing statement

claims.claim: English Wikipedia's own log of AI-related requests for comment records that the July 2025 RfC creating the criterion closed with overwhelming consensus.
claims.source: English Wikipedia project page 'Artificial intelligence', RfC log table
claims.quote: Overwhelming consensus to adopt new speedy deletion criterion

claims.claim: The French Wikipedia AI observatory's May 2026 report states that generative models evolve quickly and that the indicators observed today do not constitute definitive rules.
claims.source: Projet:Observatoire des IA, report of the community session of 9 May 2026, French Wikipedia
claims.quote: les indices observés aujourd’hui ne constituent pas des règles définitives

claims.claim: The same report lists, among the structural marks of AI-generated French Wikipedia text, roughly two to three paragraphs per section.
claims.source: Projet:Observatoire des IA, report of 9 May 2026, French Wikipedia
claims.quote: environ deux à trois paragraphes par section

claims.claim: The same report lists a homogeneous and sometimes excessively smoothed style among the structural marks of AI-generated French Wikipedia text.
claims.source: Projet:Observatoire des IA, report of 9 May 2026, French Wikipedia
claims.quote: style homogène et parfois excessivement lissé

claims.claim: The same report names stereotyped transitions, giving 'de plus', 'en outre' and 'il est important de noter que' as its examples.
claims.source: Projet:Observatoire des IA, report of 9 May 2026, French Wikipedia

claims.claim: The same report characterises the overall impression of such an article as plausible in appearance while often thin and sometimes hollow encyclopedically.
claims.source: Projet:Observatoire des IA, report of 9 May 2026, French Wikipedia

claims.claim: The German Wikipedia signs page states that LLMs often inflate the importance of the subject and suggest that the article represents or contributes to a broad topic.
claims.source: German Wikipedia advice page 'Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte', section 'Sprache und Tonfall'
claims.quote: LLMs blähen oft die Bedeutung des Themas auf
claims.page: Weichere, uneindeutige Anzeichen > Sprache und Tonfall

claims.claim: The same page lists 'reiches kulturelles Erbe' among the advertising-language formulae to watch for, and says LLMs have serious trouble keeping a neutral tone when writing about something that could be regarded as cultural heritage.
claims.source: German Wikipedia advice page 'Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte', subsection 'Werbesprache'
claims.page: Weichere, uneindeutige Anzeichen > Sprache und Tonfall > Werbesprache

claims.claim: The same page attributes the conspicuousness of AI editorial asides in German to German Wikipedia's language being traditionally more matter-of-fact and restrained.
claims.source: German Wikipedia advice page 'Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte', subsection 'Redaktionelle Kommentare'
claims.quote: die deutsche Wikipedia-Sprache traditionell sachlicher und zurückhaltender formuliert
claims.page: Weichere, uneindeutige Anzeichen > Sprache und Tonfall > Redaktionelle Kommentare

claims.claim: The same page states that in Wikipedia one typically never summarises the general idea of a block of text except in the lead section.
claims.source: German Wikipedia advice page 'Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte', subsection 'Abschnitts-Zusammenfassungen'
claims.quote: fasst man in Wikipedia typischerweise nie die allgemeine Idee eines Textblocks zusammen
claims.page: Weichere, uneindeutige Anzeichen > Sprache und Tonfall > Abschnitts-Zusammenfassungen

claims.claim: The German page declares itself to be originally an adapted translation of the English 'Signs of AI writing' page as it stood on 9 September 2025.
claims.source: German Wikipedia advice page 'Anzeichen für KI-generierte Inhalte', header notice
claims.quote: Diese Seite basiert ursprünglich als angepasste Übersetzung

claims.claim: Wiki Education ran every new article created through its programmes since 2022 through the Pangram detector and 178 of 3,078 articles came back flagged as AI.
claims.source: LiAnna Davis, Wiki Education, 'Generative AI and Wikipedia editing: What we learned in 2025'
claims.quote: A total of 178 out of the 3,078 articles came back as flagged for AI
